name: Two-ten-jack
summary: Japanese two-player trick-taking game where hearts are trumps and the 2, 10 and Jack cards determine scoring.
rules_text: Two players play multiple deals from a 52-card deck. Each deal each player is dealt 6-7 cards, remainder forms a face-down stock. Non-dealer leads first trick. Trick play: must follow lead suit if able, otherwise must play a trump if able, otherwise any card. Highest trump wins, otherwise highest of lead suit wins. Hearts are always trumps; Ace of Spades is top trump called speculation. Speculation must be played if you cannot follow otherwise with required suit/trump. When leading speculation you declare it as spade or trump. Winner of trick leads next and draws first from stock, opponent draws second, restoring hands until stock empty, then play remaining hand cards. Scoring: 2H,10H,JH +5 each; 2C,10C,JC -5 each; 2S,10S,JS,AS +1 each; 6D +1. Total per deal +5. First to 31 points over deals wins.
